_about: Round 3 of the live smoke test (PLAN-062): every row needed so that each testable feature is seen working live on the CURRENT build (QGIS 4.2.3): the features never seen live (52 on main at 58d69b4) and the features seen only on an older build whose code changed since (52, from `python tools/live_results.py --gate`). 39 of the 45 rows cover them; the six left out are D5-task-grid, V2-stop, V7-merge, V8-raster, W5-hdx-ranked and W12-guide (seen, unchanged, or needing a reader). Built with: python tools/build_full_smoke.py --plugin-zip dist/cartogen_ai_v<version>.zip --only @docs/ROUND3_ROWS.json --label round3. B4-long-request is the most expensive row: run it last and only if the provider has quota. Rows that need more than the agent route: A3-cli-bridge (a signed-in Claude Code or Codex, else write Skip), V1-update and W7-mcp-dialog (a person), F1-mcp-size (a person and an MCP client, or mcp_probe.py); F3-check-evidence needs only a terminal and W6-mcp-probe a script.
